verdict.rationale: PagerDuty offers robust rule-based automation: Event Orchestration/Rules with if-this-then-that logic, Incident Workflows that auto-trigger on conditions (e.g., all P1/P2 incidents), escalation policies, alert deduplication/suppression, and AI-driven orchestration recommendations, all configurable to trigger actions automatically on events. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of complex rule-chaining reliability at scale and more detail on failure/edge-case handling of automated rules.
